as_told.title: The New Science of Heaven and plasmoid experiments

plain: A writer named Robert Temple, in a book called The New Science of Heaven, argues that plasma, the glowing electrically charged state of matter, is the basic substance of the universe and that it is alive. Michels recommends the book himself as a great one on two occasions. The second time he brings it up while talking with a man named Adam Curry about experiments with plasmoids, small balls of plasma, and what he calls a plasma front, rather than the living-universe idea.
